title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.
inspect_text: Thick predator pelts line the floor, warm from recent bodies. The air is pungent with animal musk and hot grease. Scored into the stone behind the beds are chalk rings and tallies, identical in spacing to the marks on your own knuckles. The staff strikes stone nearby: tock… tock.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Curing Vault

inspect_text: Heavy, pungent smoke curls around drying frames loaded with salted venison and strips of hide. The center stone is stained black with resin and animal grease. Through the smoke, the rhythmic thud of the staff sounds directly through the opening: TOCK… TOCK.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A massive dressing slab, dark and greasy, flanked by neat rows of flint wedges and bone carving chisels.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.label: the worn crossing tracks
features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: The Work-Ring
summary: The deepest chamber on this level. A wide circle of chalk glows on the cave floor — the same pale light as your own lines — and inside it, golems stand unfinished: a shoulder, a head with no seams yet, slabs of raw rock. The air is thick with ash and hot clay.
inspect_text: You stop at the edge of a wide chalk circle drawn on the cave floor, glowing the same pale light as the lines you draw yourself. Inside it, golems are being made: a shoulder of dark volcanic rock, a head still without seams, slabs of raw stone waiting to be given a shape. The air tastes of ash and hot clay and burned herbs. At the ring’s center the goblin shaman works, hunched and patient, one pale hand pressed flat to the stone. Tock. Tock. A staff beating slow time against the floor.

features.label: the chalk ring
features.inspect_text: A circle of chalk drawn on the cave floor, wide enough to stand in, glowing the pale color of your own marks. It is the largest of its kind you have seen.

descriptions.summary: The chalk ring lies scuffed and broken underfoot. The half-made golems stand unfinished, and there is no hand to finish them now. Only ash, and the cold smoke of an untended fire.
descriptions.inspect_text: The work-ring’s chalk is scuffed and broken under your feet. Half-made golems stand the way they were left — a shoulder, a seamless head, slabs of raw rock — and the dying fire twists one last thread of smoke at the room’s center. The air has gone still and cold.

inspect_text: The room stinks of old kill. Fire-scorch runs up the walls; a low flat stone in the middle is black and greasy with a thousand dressings; strips of meat hang from a frame, drying in the smoke. Flies buzz in a corner. Something here was living, and not long ago.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A slab of rock worn black and smooth at its center, where the tribe dresses its kills. The smell is richest here.

title: The Convergence of Tracks
summary: The patrolling channels deepen here, cut thick into stone and dusted with white chalk. They lead straight toward the central glow, and each strike of the shaman's staff vibrates hard through the floor.
inspect_text: All the tracks of the floor seem to gather here. Four deep channels converge at clean perpendiculars, their edges powdered white with stray chalk. The air is dry and hot against your face. Every few seconds, the floor shudders with a dull, heavy thump: TOCK. Something massive is striking stone just beyond.

features.label: the worn crossing tracks
features.inspect_text: Deep grooves converging like lines on a grid, whitened by chalk dust dragged in on small feet.

title: A Glowing Crucible Chamber
summary: A wide pit of white-hot coals throbs with dry, baking heat. The stone walls are glazed red, and the air smells intensely of scorched clay and burned herbs.
inspect_text: Baking heat hits your chest like a wall. A wide stone trough glows with banked, white-hot embers that cast leaping shadows up the jagged ceiling. The air tastes bitter with chalk dust and burned mountain-sage. From the adjacent opening, the rhythm of the staff sounds close enough to touch: TOCK.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A heavy stone trough glowing white and cherry-red, radiating fierce heat that makes the air shimmer.

title: An Inner Watch-Den
summary: A warm, cramped den littered with thick wolf-pelts and hardened clay bowls. The floor vibrates with the shaman's drumming, and chalk markings cover the bedding wall.
inspect_text: Thick predator pelts line the floor, warm from recent bodies. The air is pungent with animal musk and hot grease. Scored into the stone behind the beds are chalk rings and tallies, identical in spacing to the marks on your own knuckles. The staff strikes stone nearby: tock… tock.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A collection of thick hide bundles and carved bone amulets, dusted with fine lime chalk.

title: A Cold Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A low circle of blackened stones holds a bed of sluggish, dying embers. A cold draft from a chimney overhead flattens the smoke, and the room smells of damp soot and wet earth.
inspect_text: A circle of river stones surrounds a bed of embers struggling against a downdraft. The smoke is thin and cold, sucked toward a fissure in the rock above. You warm your hands a second above the faint orange glow; the heat barely cuts through the cave's chill.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: Blackened river stones ringed around grey ash and dying orange coals. The stones are cold to the touch on their outer rim.

title: An Outer Den
summary: A low, drafty alcove where old pelts are piled against damp stone. The smell of cold musk and sour straw hangs in the air, and a small heap of gnawed bird-bones sits in the corner.
inspect_text: You have to stoop. The ceiling drops low over a scatter of moldering hides and stiff furs. A cold seep drips slowly down the back wall, plinking into a stone puddle. In the driest corner, small rodent bones lie arranged in neat little stacks of five—someone here counted them.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A small pile of dry, gnawed bones, sorted by size into neat little bundles.

title: A Scavenge Ground
summary: A cold cavern room littered with splintered bones and dried sinew. A low dressing rock sits under a chimney draft, smelling of old, dried blood and wet slate.
inspect_text: The air is cold and smells of dried sinew and stale blood. A flat limestone slab in the corner is gouged by rough flint scrapers, its surface stained dark. A draft pulls the smell away into high cracks, leaving the chamber stark and quiet.

features.label: the gutting stone
features.inspect_text: A flat limestone rock scarred by scraping blades, surrounded by dry shavings of antler and bone.

title: A Guarded Crossing
summary: A golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad stands in the middle of the room, broad as a closed door, watching nothing. The floor around it is swept clean, and the air is the quietest on this level.
inspect_text: In the center of the room a golem of dark volcanic rock, lumped and broad stands still as furniture — no mouth, eyes of flat polished pebble, a pale chalk ring circling its chest and brow. It does not react to you. The room smells of cold stone and chalk dust, and small feet have kept clear of it for a long, long time.

features.label: the chalk-ring mark
features.inspect_text: A pale chalk ring is marked on the golem’s chest and brow, in the same pale light as the frost on the sleeping wall.

title: A Fire-Pit Chamber
summary: A shallow pit of embers glows in the middle of the floor, ringed with stones scored black by long use. Smoke layers flat against the ceiling like a low roof, and the room is warm enough to sweat in.
inspect_text: Heat meets you at the doorway. A shallow pit of embers throbs low in the center of the room, its ring of stones scarred by a thousand proddings with a fire-stick. The smoke hangs in a flat layer overhead, and your shadow stretches long across the floor. It smells of ash and old grease.

features.label: the ember pit
features.inspect_text: A ring of fire-scarred stones, and inside it embers that never quite die out. The coals breathe, orange and patient.

title: A Den
summary: A low-ceilinged den, thick with old hides and fur. A fire has burned down to ash against one wall, and gnawed bones are stacked neatly in a corner. The air is heavy with damp fur and musk.

features.label: the bone pile
features.inspect_text: A neat stack of long bones, gnawed clean and arranged almost carelessly — the way you’d tidy something you might want again.

title: The Mushroom Grove
summary: A cavern floor is choked with pale mushrooms, all leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air smells of wet earth and something sweet, like crushed fruit.
inspect_text: Pale mushrooms crowd the floor, every cap leaning toward the glowing canopy above. The air holds wet earth and something sweet — crushed fruit, or a thing that ripened down here.

features.label: the pale mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Cluster after cluster of knee-high mushrooms sprout from the moist cave soil. Their pale spongy caps all lean uniformly toward the canopy above, as if turning toward a subterranean sun.

features.label: the glowing canopy
features.inspect_text: High above, living roots knit into an expansive vaulted ceiling woven with luminescent lichen and moss. A soft teal glow filters down through the gloom.

title: A Glowing Clearing
summary: A wide clearing lit by drifting spores that pulse slowly, like a heartbeat. Overhead a false sky shimmers, bright enough to read by, wrong enough to notice.
inspect_text: Spores drift across this clearing at a slow, even pulse, lighting the ground beneath your feet. Above, a false sky shimmers faintly — steady enough to read by, wrong enough that you notice.

features.label: the drifting spores
features.inspect_text: Glittering spores drift through the still air in lazy arcs, pulsing brighter and dimmer on an even, four-second cadence like a slow subterranean breath.

features.label: the false sky
features.inspect_text: The cavern ceiling shimmers like an artificial twilight sky. It offers just enough illumination to cast sharp shadows and reveal the path ahead.

title: The Root Tangle
summary: Great roots as thick as your arm weave through the walls here, and between them the forest breathes in and out. Somewhere at the edge of your hearing, something keeps time with it.
inspect_text: Great roots lace the walls and ceiling here, and between them the quiet forest breathes. You listen for a moment; somewhere in the dark, something answers on the same slow rhythm.

features.label: the root tangle
features.inspect_text: Gnarled roots as thick as your torso twist through cracks in the stone walls. They pulse with faint sap-warmth, flexing almost imperceptibly against the rock.

features.label: the living walls
features.inspect_text: Limestone blocks split by ancient wood. Cool water weeps down the fissures, feeding dense coats of dark moss.

title: A Still Pool Glade

features.label: the still pool

features.label: the ripples

title: The Fungus Hollow
summary: Across the hollow, mushrooms stand like sentinels, each near the height of your knee, planted in even ranks. Their caps throw pale light across the stone.
inspect_text: Pale light falls across the hollow from a hundred mushroom caps, each set evenly apart like a field that was planted on purpose. The light is cool and steady, good enough to see by.

features.label: the sentinel mushrooms
features.inspect_text: Stout mushrooms stand in orderly, grid-like rows across the damp earth. Their flat caps cast pale rings of light onto the soil like miniature lanterns.

features.label: the spore light
features.inspect_text: Cool phosphorescence emanating from beneath the mushroom gills, lighting up the soil in quiet pools.

title: A Chalked Trail
summary: Faint chalk lines run along the floor at your feet, worn almost to nothing, leading deeper into the dark. Someone drew a path here long ago and left it.
inspect_text: Thin chalk lines run ahead of you along the stone, worn to ghosts of their old marks. They keep to the center of the passage and lead deeper, as if someone once walked this way often.

features.label: the chalk trail
features.inspect_text: Thin white lines drawn with ancient mineral chalk trace the floor down the center of the lane. They have faded over decades of foot traffic, yet the geometry remains straight and deliberate.

features.label: the worn marks
features.inspect_text: Faint geometric intersections scored into the bedrock. Someone mapped this corridor with precision long before you walked it.

title: The Whispering Ferns
summary: Fern-like growths as tall as your shoulder line the walls, rustling though there is no wind. They whisper in a language that sounds almost familiar.
inspect_text: Tall fern-shaped growths line the walls on both sides, and they murmur without any wind to move them. The sound is almost language, almost your name, never quite either.

features.label: the whispering ferns
features.inspect_text: Towering fronds as tall as your shoulder rustle against each other in dry, rhythmic sibilance. In the rustling you catch fragments that sound uncannily like whispered syllables.

features.label: the rustling sound
features.inspect_text: The fronds move without wind, swaying in gentle synchrony with the breathing of the root-canopy.

title: A Shaft of Sky
summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

summary: A crack in the cavern roof opens far above, and through it falls a light like starlight, pooling onto a bed of moss. You tilt your head back to watch it.
inspect_text: Far above, a crack in the roof lets in a column of pale light that pools on the moss by your feet. It is the first true light you have seen down here, and it is very old.

features.label: the shaft of sky
features.inspect_text: A sheer chimney cut into the vault far above. Through it falls a clean, vertical beam of silver starlight, cutting through the damp mist like a spear.

features.label: the moss bed
features.inspect_text: A thick velvet carpet of emerald moss thriving directly in the beam of starlight. It is cool and resilient beneath your boots.

title: The Deep Glade
summary: The air here is still and old, and the hum of this forest is loudest at your back. Glowing vines hang around you like curtains, their light slow and steady.
inspect_text: Still, old air lines this glade, and the forest hum is loudest here. Curtains of glowing vine hang heavy around you, their light riding the same slow pulse as the spores of the outer woods.

features.label: the glowing vines
features.inspect_text: Thick curtains of braided vine hang from the boughs like tapestries. Their pale teal veins throb in time with the forest's deep pulse.

features.label: the forest hum
features.inspect_text: A low vibration that thrums in your teeth and chest. The deep roots of the back rank anchor the entire cavern.

title: The King's Grove
summary: The forest parts into a wide, still chamber. At its heart, enthroned in roots and pale light, sits the elf king, watching the entrance — watching you.
inspect_text: The trees open at last into a wide, still chamber. In a throne woven of roots and pale light sits the elf king, and he is looking at the entrance, at you, with no hurry at all.

features.label: the root throne
features.inspect_text: A grand seat grown seamlessly out of living ash-grey roots and curled bark. Ancient carvings mark its high backrest, worn smooth by centuries of royal repose.

features.label: the pale light
features.inspect_text: A concentrated corona of silver-green illumination bathing the center of the grove, undisturbed by drafts or smoke.

descriptions.summary: The forest opens into a wide, still chamber. Where the elf king once sat enthroned in roots and pale light, only a hollowed throne of grey bark remains.

title: The North Offering
summary: A great dish of black glass stands against the north wall like an open mouth, gathering the ring that circles the board toward it.
inspect_text: The store of the board: where the gathered stones were poured and counted. The glass around it is cool, but you know the heat this room was made to hold.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass, deep as a man's chest. Its lip is scored where embers have been poured in and cleared away a thousand times.

features.label: the black glass
features.inspect_text: Sheets of polished volcanic glass form the foundation of the north store, cool and slick beneath your boots.

title: The South Store
summary: The ring bends south into a second dish, shallower than the first, and at its bottom a single ember smoulders.
inspect_text: The far store of the board. One seed has been left behind — warm, steady, waiting for a hand to move it.

features.label: the fire-bowl
features.inspect_text: A wide dish of black glass. A single ember smoulders at its bottom, the last seed of the south store.

features.label: the banked ember
features.inspect_text: A stubborn node of cherry-red heat pulsing softly in the soot of the south store.

title: A Basin of Cooling Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. In its center a broad depression holds one red coal that never quite dies.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: A single coal breathes in the depression, skirted by black glass. It does not warm the room — only the memory of warmth.

features.label: the thermal cracks
features.inspect_text: Hairline fractures spiderweb through the black glass floor, radiating dull warmth from heat chambers below.

title: A Basin of Kept Embers
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A film of embers lies over the glass, caught like seeds before sowing.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Tiny embers fleck the floor like a scatter of seed, slightly warmer under the fingers than the surrounding glass.

title: A Basin Between Two Stores
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two faint lines of carved glass race away to either hand, joining the ring at the far store.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Two scored lines run out of this chamber and vanish around the curve of the ring.

features.label: the glass basin

title: A Basin of Ashen Glass
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The bowl is cracked and cold, its stones pale as ash.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The crack runs through the center of the bowl. Whatever burned here has long been taken.

title: A Basin That Remembers Fire
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A dull warmth rises through the floor, here at the board's one true hearth.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Heat wells up gently through the seams. Beneath, you sense the same dead fire you have felt all along: banked, waiting.

title: A Basin Near the South Store
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring bends south toward a tall dark offering dish.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The southern store is a tall column of shadow on the rim, its dish holding the last of the board's gathered light.

title: A Basin of the Turning Board
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The glass underfoot is worn to a shine, as if countless stones were slid across it.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

features.label: the glass basin
features.inspect_text: The floor is glass worn mirror-smooth, the recorded arc of a thousand unseen moves.

features.label: the ash drifts
features.inspect_text: Fine grey soot and volcanic silt collected in the corners and grooves of the basin, shifting under draft and footstep.

title: A Basin Where Seeds Were Slid
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. A scatter of seed-shaped embers sits in the bowl, none of them lit.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Embers sit one by one, evenly spaced, exactly as seeds would be set out before a game.

title: A Basin of Deep Stillness
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Nothing moves. The stillness here is older than the black glass itself.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The air is cold and still. Even the ancient warmth of the board does not reach here.

title: A Basin of the Long Ring
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring stretches long in both directions, one arc fading into gloom.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The ring doubles back on itself for a long way before either store or center appears.

title: A Basin on the Far Arc
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Far across the dark, the heart of the board glows a faint, banked orange.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. Across the dark the heart-pit burns at a steady, unhurried orange.

title: A Basin at the North Store
summary: A round chamber floored in black glass. Northward, a monumental bowl gathers the ring into itself.
inspect_text: A round chamber floored in black glass. The north store's dish shelves up beyond the rim, its mouth drinking the ring.

title: The Heart-Pit
summary: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass, and in it, on a cradle of embers, a fire burns — patient, watchful, alone.
inspect_text: The ring's center opens into a shallow pit of black glass. In the cradle, a clot of embers holds to a deep, steady heat. Something in it watches the edge of the pit.

features.label: the coals
features.inspect_text: In the cradle of the pit, a clot of embers burns with a deep, steady heat. It does not crackle. It does not spread. It simply holds.

features.label: the obsidian cradle
features.inspect_text: A sunken saucer of seamless black glass engineered to concentrate the cavern's elemental heat at its center.

descriptions.summary: The heart-pit is empty. Where the Fire Elemental burned, only a round cradle of black glass remains, still warm, holding a faint spiral of ash.

title: High Exhaust Flue
summary: A soaring stone cavern at the northern peak of the mine. Giant iron chimney flues channel hot boiler exhaust into the dark above.
inspect_text: Riveted iron chimneys hiss with venting steam. The rock here is dry and hot, crusted with deposits of white chalk dust blown up from the deep stamp mills.

features.label: the central exhaust flue
features.inspect_text: Thick iron plates bolted together with heavy rivets. It vibrates with the steady pulse of boilers operating far below.

title: Deep Drainage Sump
summary: The southwestern terminus of the lower drifts. Warm, mineral-rich mine water pools in a wide stone basin beneath clanking pump rods.
inspect_text: Steam-driven reciprocating pumps draw chalky water out of the sump through perforated copper pipes. White sediment coats every timber support.

features.label: the steam sump pump
features.inspect_text: A vertical walking-beam engine powered by overhead steam lines, driving pump buckets deep into the flooded sump.

title: Eastern Tailing Dump
summary: The southeastern corner of the workings opens into an immense cavern filled with mounds of crushed grey rock and glittering chalk fragments.
inspect_text: Wooden catwalks overhang vast tailing mounds left by the ore mills. Narrow-gauge tracks end here at iron dump bumpers.

features.label: the tailing chute
features.inspect_text: Heavy sheet iron stained with mineral wash, used to slide crushed gangue rock down into the lower abyss.

title: Lower Sluice Drift
summary: A low-ceilinged drift where muddy runoff flows along wooden sluice boxes lined with coarse canvas.
inspect_text: The canvas riffles catch heavy particles of raw chalk and quartz. Overhead steam pipes keep the water from freezing.

features.label: wooden sluice box
features.inspect_text: Rough-sawn planks slick with fine white chalk slime.

title: Steam Drill Station
summary: The air is thick with chalk dust. A heavy rotary drill mounted on an iron screw-column bites into a pale rock seam.
inspect_text: Flexible canvas-braided steam hoses snake across the floor to power the chattering pneumatic chisel. Ear-splitting echoes linger.

features.label: the columnar steam drill
features.inspect_text: A brass-sleeved piston assembly with hardened steel drill bits.

title: Rotary Cutting Chamber
summary: Massive circular cutting heads with hardened teeth have gouged semicircular channels into the solid limestone.
inspect_text: Steam conduits hiss overhead. Deep cuts in the stone expose bright veins of luminescent chalk that glow with a faint pale violet light.

features.label: exposed chalk vein
features.inspect_text: The stone is cool and softly luminous, brittle to the touch and powdery.

title: West Timber Shoring
summary: Heavy square-cut pine timbers brace a fragile ceiling where the strata have sheared into jagged tiers.
inspect_text: Iron wedges and screw jacks reinforce the joints. White chalk dust clings to the rough bark like winter frost.

features.label: heavy timber jack
features.inspect_text: Thick square balks of timber held under tons of mountain weight by iron turnbuckles.

title: Pneumatic Pipe Junction
summary: A hub of copper and iron pipelines bolted to the wall. Manometers click and flutter behind round glass bezels.
inspect_text: High-pressure steam and compressed air lines divide here, branching north toward the flue and east toward the village.

features.label: brass valve manifold
features.inspect_text: Heavy brass turncocks with worn wooden handles, regulating pressure to the drills.

title: Raw Chalk Face
summary: A broad mining face where pickaxes and wedges have laid bare a pure bank of brilliant white chalk.
inspect_text: The chalk is chalky and brittle, but when touched with iron it hums with faint resonance. Broken fragments litter the track.

features.label: the white chalk face
features.inspect_text: A sheer wall of pure white chalk. Fine dust rises in small clouds at every step.

title: Ore Incline Station
summary: A busy transfer depot where steep cable rails lead up toward the village western terrace.
inspect_text: Empty wooden ore wagons wait on side spurs while loaded tubs are hitched to moving steel haulage ropes.

features.label: cable haulage drum
features.inspect_text: A grooved iron drum wound with grease-stained steel cable, turned by an enclosed steam turbine.

title: High-Pressure Steam Vent
summary: A deafening hiss echoes through this narrow passage where an expansion joint on the main steam main vents excess pressure.
inspect_text: Clouds of damp white mist obscure the ceiling, condensation dripping down the walls in steady rivulets.

features.label: the pressure relief valve
features.inspect_text: A heavy brass spring-loaded relief valve releasing bursts of scalding white vapor.

title: Powder Magazine Drift
summary: A dry, reinforced dead-end passage barricaded by double sheet-iron doors marked with warning stencils.
inspect_text: Sealed copper canisters of blasting powder and fuses sit on raised wooden pallets, kept strictly dry away from steam drips.

features.label: iron powder chest
features.inspect_text: A heavy lead-lined iron box secured with a massive brass padlock.

title: Upper Chalk Gallery
summary: An elevated drift carved through a high shelf of mineralized chalk. The air is cooler here, smelling of dry dust.
inspect_text: Old hand-chiseled niches hold smoking grease lamps that cast flickering yellow light across glittering white walls.

features.label: chiseled lamp niche
features.inspect_text: A hollow carved into the chalk wall holding a tin lamp with a sputtering wick.

title: Ventilation Shaft Head
summary: A wide vertical shaft drops into dark depths below, covered by an iron grating that vibrates with rising air currents.
inspect_text: A steam-driven squirrel-cage fan draws foul air up from the lower workings and exhausts it toward the northern chimney.

features.label: the draft fan
features.inspect_text: A twelve-foot iron fan wheel spinning within a riveted shroud.

title: High Boiler Platform
summary: An iron gantry perched on stone ledges holds a secondary Scotch marine boiler wrapped in asbestos lagging.
inspect_text: Gauges show nominal boiler pressure. The furnace door glows cherry red through draft louvers, radiating intense heat.

features.label: the secondary boiler
features.inspect_text: A horizontal cylindrical boiler with brass fittings and copper water-level tubes.

title: Chimney Catwalk
summary: A narrow steel mesh catwalk running along the rocky crags just below the apex exhaust flue.
inspect_text: Far below, the lights of the outer mine drift twinkle through rising plumes of warm steam and drifting white chalk specks.

features.label: steel catwalk railing
features.inspect_text: Sturdy tubular steel railing bolted directly into the cavern wall.

title: Flue Service Platform
summary: An iron staging platform overlooking the eastern bank of the main ventilation chimneys.
inspect_text: Maintenance tools, spare gaskets, and spanners hang on shadow boards beside grease-stained overalls.

features.label: tool shadow board
features.inspect_text: Rows of heavy forged wrenches and brass oil cans ready for chimney maintenance.

title: Condenser Station
summary: A maze of copper coil radiators where spent steam is cooled back into water for boiler feed tanks.
inspect_text: Trickling water splashes inside sheet-metal shrouds, keeping the air cool and humid.

features.label: copper condenser coils
features.inspect_text: Long loops of ribbed copper pipe glistening with bead-like droplets of distilled water.

title: Steam Whistle Tower
summary: A raised stone outcrop supporting a three-chime brass steam whistle connected to shift-timer clockwork.
inspect_text: When triggered, its booming note echoes across all three concentric rings of the floor to signal shift changes.

features.label: the shift whistle
features.inspect_text: Three stepped brass bells linked by lever linkage to a heavy spring valve.

title: Upper Haulage Drift
summary: A wide, timbered passage with double iron track lines running downhill along the eastern slope.
inspect_text: Iron carts with flanged wheels roll by with a rhythmic metallic clatter, pushed by grease-coated conveyor cables.

features.label: double rail tracks
features.inspect_text: Stout iron rails spiked to oak cross-ties, polished smooth by countless ore wagons.

title: Winch Cable Hall
summary: A cavernous vault dominated by a massive twin-cylinder steam winding engine mounted on granite footings.
inspect_text: Heavy steel ropes sing with tension as they pull loaded ore rakes up from the eastern stope.

features.label: twin-cylinder winch
features.inspect_text: Cast-iron engine bed supporting counter-weighted flywheels and gleaming brass piston rods.

title: Bright Chalk Seam
summary: The mining drift cuts through an exceptionally pure seam of chalk that shines with distinct inner light.
inspect_text: Miners' picks have left rhythmic cross-hatchings on the wall. Small powdery heaps of chalk crumble underfoot.

features.label: glowing chalk ledge
features.inspect_text: A natural shelf where the chalk crystals exhibit high purity and pale luminescent luminescence.

title: East Rail Staging
summary: A bustling transit junction where eastern mining lines link with the approach to the village residential quarter.
inspect_text: Carts are shunted between sidings by burly workers with iron coupling bars. Lanterns glow red and green.

features.label: switch-track lever
features.inspect_text: A counter-weighted ground throw lever used to align the iron rail frogs.

title: Compressed Air Main
summary: A long straight drift carrying a twenty-inch riveted steel pneumatic main wrapped in tarred burlap.
inspect_text: The pipe thrums continuously with the pulse of surface-air compressors, supplying air to the deep stope drills.

features.label: the main air conduit
features.inspect_text: A huge riveted cylinder with expansion joints and brass pressure inspection ports.

title: Shored-Up Fault Drift
summary: A fractured section of cavern where a natural tectonic fault has been buttressed by thick iron I-beams.
inspect_text: Water seeps through hairline fissures, tasting faintly of sulfur and chalk minerals.

features.label: iron buttress arch
features.inspect_text: Heavy rolled steel arches bolted to stone footers to arrest rock settlement.

title: Piston Pumping Floor
summary: Two horizontal steam pumps work in opposing tandem, their brass crossheads gliding along polished guide bars.
inspect_text: They suck water from the eastern drainage ditches and force it up to the central condensator tanks.

features.label: horizontal steam pump
features.inspect_text: A gleaming machine smelling of hot cylinder oil and clean steam.

title: Crushed Rock Chute
summary: A dusty loading bay where overhead bins discharge gravel and crushed chalk directly into hopper cars.
inspect_text: Operated by long wooden levers that open slide gates at the bottom of the timber funnels.

features.label: hopper discharge gate
features.inspect_text: A sliding steel gate operated by a counter-balanced hand lever.

title: Heavy Rail Yard
summary: A sprawling yard with four parallel tracks lined with heavy steel-sided hopper cars awaiting assembly into trains.
inspect_text: Brake wagons and flatcars loaded with fresh timbers stand ready for the night shift.

features.label: brakeman's caboose cart
features.inspect_text: A sturdy wooden wagon fitted with a hand-screw brake wheel and a red oil lantern.

title: Slag Runoff Drift
summary: The tunnel runs along a channel of dark vitrified slag from old smelting trials, cooled into glassy black ridges.
inspect_text: Chalk dust covers the black glassy stone like powdered sugar, crunched beneath heavy boots.

features.label: vitrified slag ridge
features.inspect_text: Smooth, rippled black stone fused by ancient high heat before modern steam methods took over.

title: East Sump Drift
summary: A damp, cool passage draining seepage from the eastern tailing heaps toward the southern fault.
inspect_text: The floor is covered with duckboard walkways floating above six inches of milky, chalk-clouded water.

features.label: floating duckboards
features.inspect_text: Thick pine planks nailed together, sloshing gently as you tread on them.

title: Hydraulic Lift Basin
summary: A high-ceilinged cavern housing a water-hydraulic cargo platform used to hoist heavy equipment from lower cuts.
inspect_text: A massive brass-sleeved hydraulic ram glides into a vertical cylinder, driven by high-pressure accumulator tanks.

features.label: hydraulic ram cylinder
features.inspect_text: A mirror-polished bronze ram standing thirty feet high within iron guide rails.

title: Deepest Chalk Stope
summary: The deepest working level of the chalk mine. The walls are pure blinding white, carved in stepped tiers.
inspect_text: Miners' chisels have squared the blocks with precision. The air is cool, still, and charged with static tingling.

features.label: stepped chalk bench
features.inspect_text: Evenly cut tiers of chalk stone, glowing with an inner luminescence.

title: Abyssal Rock Fault
summary: A yawning natural chasm cuts across the floor, bridged by heavy timber stringers and steel guard ropes.
inspect_text: Cool air currents rise from bottomless darkness below, carrying the faint sound of underground waterfalls.

features.label: the timber bridge
features.inspect_text: Heavy square balks bolted together with iron tie-rods, spanning the black gulf.

title: Submerged Rail Drift
summary: An abandoned rail line where iron tracks plunge under murky, chalk-white water.
inspect_text: Rusting wagons sit submerged to their axles, abandoned during a sudden underground water breakthrough.

features.label: submerged ore car
features.inspect_text: A wrought-iron cart sitting silently underwater, coated in lime and chalk scale.

title: South Drainage Sluice
summary: A wide masonry aqueduct carrying runoff water out of the mine, linking directly to the village drainage system.
inspect_text: Iron sluice gates with handwheel screws control the volume of water diverted into the communal cisterns.

features.label: sluice handwheel screw
features.inspect_text: A massive bronze wheel operating a geared rack and pinion on the sluice gate.

title: The Deepest Cut
summary: The lowest point in the entire southern excavation. The ceiling vanishes into black shadows overhead.
inspect_text: Here the miners struck the Great Chalk Seam—a solid stratum of stone so luminous that miners work without lanterns.

features.label: the Great Chalk Seam
features.inspect_text: A monument of pure glowing stone. Looking at it gives a quiet sense of vast, unbroken peace.

title: Sluice Control Basin
summary: A deep circular settling basin where milky mine runoff drops its heavy chalk sediment before release.
inspect_text: Workers scrape the settled white paste into drying tubs to be baked into chalk blocks for the town.

features.label: settling basin weir
features.inspect_text: A stone weir with overflow notches that keep the chalk silt contained.

title: Geode Cavern
summary: The mine tunnel cuts directly through a hollow pocket lined with giant calcite and chalk crystals up to eight feet long.
inspect_text: The crystals chime with a faint resonant vibration when the distant steam engines stroke.

features.label: towering chalk crystals
features.inspect_text: Prismatic hexagonal pillars of luminous chalk growing in interlocking clusters.

title: Runoff Sluice Gallery
summary: A long vaulted corridor echoing with the rush of clean water flowing along stone channels.
inspect_text: Copper pipes run parallel to the water flume, feeding steam power to drainage pumps further west.

features.label: masonry flume wall
features.inspect_text: Dressed stone blocks pointed with hydraulic mortar that resists water erosion.

title: Rock Tailing Dump West
summary: A secondary tailing dump where waste shale and quartz are stacked against cavern buttresses.
inspect_text: Old hand-barrows and broken shovel handles lie discarded among the grey rubble heaps.

features.label: broken hand-barrow
features.inspect_text: A splintered wooden cart with an iron hoop wheel, abandoned when a weld snapped.

title: Lower Rail Spur
summary: A quiet siding where miners leave their heavy coats and tin lunch pails on iron pegboards.
inspect_text: A small coke-fired brazier provides warmth for tired workers taking their brief ten-minute rest break.

features.label: warm coke brazier
features.inspect_text: A perforated iron drum glowing with cherry-red coals, radiating welcome dry heat.

title: Sump Pump Station West
summary: The western auxiliary pumping vault, filled with the rhythmic thud-chunk of a Cornish beam pump.
inspect_text: A heavy wooden balance bob rocks up and down, lifting eighty gallons of water with every single stroke.

features.label: Cornish beam pump
features.inspect_text: A towering oak beam bound in wrought iron, rocking on massive trunnion bearings.

title: The Chalk Excavation Pit
summary: A massive open excavation pit where the richest chalk beds are mined in wide concentric steps.
inspect_text: Scores of workers once swung picks here under steam-lamp glare. The pit floor glows with soft, perpetual phosphorescence.

features.label: the central quarry floor
features.inspect_text: Smooth white floor scarred by chisel marks, giving off a gentle, unwavering pale glow.

title: The Main Haulage Tracks
summary: A major railway junction where the eastern drifts converge. Overhead steam lines feed the electric arc lamps illuminating the switchyard.
inspect_text: Iron wagons roll constantly toward the tipples. Beneath a cast-iron drainage grating, a deep storm pipe gurgles with fast-running water.

features.label: cast-iron drain grate
features.inspect_text: A heavy circular iron grating set into the floor. Peering through reveals a hollow conduit heading north under the military walls.

title: The Old Drainage Conduit
summary: A forgotten brick-and-iron storm drainage pipe running deep underneath the garrison foundations. Water sloshes to your ankles.
inspect_text: The air is damp and metallic. Farther in, an iron service ladder climbs up toward a round access hatch directly beneath the command tent.

features.label: the iron climb ladder
features.inspect_text: Rusty iron rungs anchored into the brick wall, ascending toward an overhead trapdoor.

title: North Approach Plaza
summary: A broad paved plaza at the northern apex of the village. Ahead, the massive iron-and-brass bulkhead of the military complex looms over the road.
inspect_text: Steam pipes run along high stone pylons to heat the open plaza. Armed guards look down from the garrison catwalks with ready crossbows.

features.label: the approach road paving
features.inspect_text: Smooth-worn granite cobbles flanked by copper gas-flambeaux.

title: Water Spring Terrace
summary: A tranquil corner where cold subterranean springs bubble from living rock into tiered stone basins.
inspect_text: Villagers fill brass canteens and wooden buckets. Overhead copper pipes radiate gentle warmth to keep the damp terrace comfortable.

features.label: the natural stone fountain
features.inspect_text: A natural moss-edged hollow in limestone overflowing with cold, clear drinking water.

title: South Overlook Terrace
summary: A high stone parapet at the southeastern tip of the village, looking down into the bustling eastern mining drifts.
inspect_text: A low stone wall keeps children safe from the drop. Lanterns flicker along the railing, overlooking the mine carts below.

features.label: parapet overlook wall
features.inspect_text: Solid limestone blocks cut with drainage scuppers, polished smooth by leaning elbows.

title: Wash Basin Terrace
summary: A communal stone terrace lined with laundry tubs fed by warm condensed-water pipes from the central boiler.
inspect_text: Lines of heavy canvas work-shirts and overalls hang drying in warm air rising from floor grates.

features.label: communal washing trough
features.inspect_text: A long zinc-lined stone trough filled with warm steaming water.

title: Steam Pipe Alley
summary: A narrow residential passage shadowed by thick overhead pipes wrapped in tarred canvas.
inspect_text: The pipes creak and tick with steam expansion. Front doors of stone cottages open directly into the warm lane.

features.label: insulated steam main
features.inspect_text: A ten-inch pipe fitted with brass bleed-valves venting gentle puffs of vapor.

title: Radiator Row
summary: A row of two-story miner cottages, their front walls fitted with heavy cast-iron radiators that heat the entire street.
inspect_text: Children sit on the warm radiator benches to play pebble-games, laughing in the gentle glow of gas lamps.

features.label: cast-iron street radiator
features.inspect_text: An ornate fluted radiator radiating steady, dry heat into the lane.

title: Maryam's Apothecary
summary: A fragrant, orderly stone shop smelling intensely of eucalyptus, dried mint, and camphor balm.
inspect_text: Maryam works here behind rows of glass tincture bottles, compounding soothing lung-syrups for miners suffering from chalk dust.

features.label: apothecary mortar and pestle
features.inspect_text: A heavy granite mortar filled with freshly crushed eucalyptus leaves and honey.

title: West Tool Shed
summary: A communal repair shed where miners sharpen drill steels and pickaxes on steam-turned emery wheels.
inspect_text: Showers of bright orange sparks illuminate the ceiling whenever a worker presses an edge against the spinning stone.

features.label: steam-driven grinding wheel
features.inspect_text: A thick circular grindstone spinning smoothly via an overhead leather drive-belt.

title: Tariq's Clockwork Workshop
summary: A shop crammed with brass gears, clockwork escapements, aneroid manometers, and dissected steam valves.
inspect_text: Tariq sits at his high bench with magnifying loupes, delicate tweezers, and miniature soldering torches.

features.label: watchmaker's bench
features.inspect_text: A bench covered in tiny brass cogwheels, balance springs, and pressure diaphragms.

title: Gaslamp Lane
summary: A quiet, curving street lit by polished brass gas lamps mounted on wrought-iron wall brackets.
inspect_text: The gas flames burn with a calm, emerald-tinted white light, fueled by purified mine gas.

features.label: wrought-iron gas bracket
features.inspect_text: A finely scrolled bracket holding a glass lamp housing a bright incandescent mantle.

title: Upper Residential Terrace
summary: A row of well-kept miner homes built into natural rock alcoves. Potted cave-ferns line the stone stair steps.
inspect_text: Quiet murmurs and the clinking of spoons against tin bowls drift from open windows.

features.label: stone threshold
features.inspect_text: A clean scrubbed threshold flanked by potted white-cap ferns.

title: North Cliff Path
summary: A rising stone path chiseled into the cavern wall, offering a sweeping view across the entire village rooftops.
inspect_text: Iron railings guard the edge. The warm breeze carries the smell of fresh bread and coal smoke.

features.label: chiseled safety rail
features.inspect_text: Solid iron stanchions supporting a taut steel safety cable.

title: North Guard Slope
summary: A steep cobblestone ramp descending from the northern gate toward the eastern village artisan quarter.
inspect_text: Armed military sentries pace the wall above, keeping a watchful eye on every civilian who passes below.

features.label: cobblestone ramp
features.inspect_text: Heavy granite sets laid in fish-scale pattern to provide traction for loaded handcarts.

title: Iron Stair Landing
summary: A junction where several iron spiral staircases link the upper cliff terraces with the lower artisan lanes.
inspect_text: Cast-iron treads ring like muffled bells underfoot as workers run up and down between shifts.

features.label: spiral stair column
features.inspect_text: A central fluted cast-iron column supporting open-mesh spiral treads.

title: East Tenement Row
summary: Multi-story timber-and-stone tenements housing several dozen miner families. Washing lines crisscross overhead.
inspect_text: Small children peer from high balcony railings while neighbors converse across the narrow gap between eaves.

features.label: timber balcony railing
features.inspect_text: Sturdy pine rail polished by generations of leaning forearms.

title: Weaver's Workshop
summary: A spacious workshop resounding with the rhythmic clack-thud of steam-powered fly-shuttle looms.
inspect_text: Spinning wheels and looms produce heavy duck canvas, filter veils for chalk dust, and durable denim trousers.

features.label: steam-powered loom
features.inspect_text: A cast-iron loom frame with flying shuttles dancing across tight cotton warp threads.

title: East Pipe Junction
summary: A wide street intersection dominated by a freestanding iron gantry supporting district heating mains.
inspect_text: Valve wheels and steam traps hiss rhythmically as condensate is discharged into road gutters.

features.label: overhead pipe gantry
features.inspect_text: Lattice-girder steel arch spanning the street carrying three parallel lagged pipes.

title: Miner Cottage Row East
summary: A tranquil cul-de-sac of whitewashed stone cottages with brass doorknobs and polished windowpanes.
inspect_text: Small brass nameplates beside front doors commemorate miner families who have lived here for generations.

features.label: polished brass nameplate
features.inspect_text: Engraved with family crests and decades of unbroken mining service.

title: Lantern Lane
summary: A cheerful market street where vendors set up trestle tables selling tin mugs, leather boots, and dried mushrooms.
inspect_text: Overhead festoon lanterns cast warm orange circles onto the wet cobblestones.

features.label: vendor trestle table
features.inspect_text: Heavy wooden trestles displaying hand-stitched leather boots and tin mess kits.

title: Boiler Exhaust Lane
summary: A narrow alley flanked by the brick blast-walls of a district steam-boosting station.
inspect_text: The air is warm and dry, smelling faintly of clean mineral water and coal smoke.

features.label: brick booster wall
features.inspect_text: Solid red engineering brick tied together with heavy star-pattern iron wall washers.

title: East Cliff Terrace
summary: A scenic promenade overlooking the lower rail staging yards of the mine, lined with benches.
inspect_text: Off-duty miners sit here with clay pipes, watching the distant shunting of ore trains below.

features.label: timber bench
features.inspect_text: A curved oak bench bolted to the parapet, worn smooth by generations of workers.

title: Memorial Wall
summary: A somber stretch of cavern wall faced with polished slate tablets listing the names of miners lost in cave-ins.
inspect_text: Small oil lamps burn in carved recesses beneath the names. Fresh cavern ferns have been placed at the base.

features.label: slate memorial tablet
features.inspect_text: Dozens of names etched in gold leaf, commemorating those who fell in the lower drifts.

title: South Mushroom Lane
summary: A cool, quiet street running parallel to the agricultural mushroom caverns. The smell of damp loam is strong.
inspect_text: Wagons loaded with wooden compost flats rumble by, driven by quiet garden workers.

features.label: compost wagon
features.inspect_text: A low-slung wooden wagon piled high with steaming, enriched cave loam.

title: Spore Drying Shed
summary: A ventilated wooden building where mature mushroom spores are dried on fine brass mesh racks.
inspect_text: Warm air is piped beneath the drying tables to dehydrate the harvest for winter storage.

features.label: brass spore drying rack
features.inspect_text: Tier upon tier of fine wire mesh dusted with velvety purple mushroom spores.

title: Stepped Mushroom Beds
summary: A vast vaulted chamber lined with terraced wooden beds blooming with thousands of white and blue edible caps.
inspect_text: Fine water misting nozzles spray the beds every ten minutes, powered by the village water line.

features.label: misting nozzle assembly
features.inspect_text: Brass spray heads atomizing water into a cool, refreshing fog.

title: Southern Runoff Trench
summary: A deep, masonry-lined drainage channel dividing the agricultural zone from the residential terraces.
inspect_text: Iron footbridges cross the water at regular intervals, connecting lanes on either side.

features.label: arched iron footbridge
features.inspect_text: Graceful cast-iron arch with safety handrails spanning the rushing channel.

title: Root Cellar Vault
summary: A cool stone vault dug deep into living rock, used to store dried provisions, smoked fish, and root crops.
inspect_text: Heavy timber bins stand filled with pickled vegetables and wheel upon wheel of aged cave-cheese.

features.label: oak storage bin
features.inspect_text: Massive iron-strapped oak chest filled with wax-sealed root provisions.

title: Communal Steam Baths
summary: A pillared bathhouse with three stepped pools of hot, mineral-rich water fed directly by condensed steam lines.
inspect_text: Miners soak their aching joints here after hard ten-hour shifts, scrubbing off white chalk dust with pumice.

features.label: hot mineral pool
features.inspect_text: Clear turquoise water steaming gently at a soothing temperature.

title: Condenser Cistern
summary: A massive cylindrical copper storage tank holding ten thousand gallons of purified drinking water.
inspect_text: A glass sight-tube shows the water level, while copper faucets allow villagers to draw water freely.

features.label: copper water faucet
features.inspect_text: A gleaming brass turn-handle faucet dripping into a carved stone basin.

title: Spring Intake Chamber
summary: A masonry vault surrounding the purest underground spring, fitted with charcoal and sand filtration beds.
inspect_text: The water runs crystal clear over white quartz pebbles before entering the village mains.

features.label: sand filtration bed
features.inspect_text: Layers of graded quartz sand and activated charcoal filtering every drop.

title: The Village Square
summary: The beating heart of the village. A broad circular plaza paved in concentric stone rings, surrounded by gas lamps.
inspect_text: At the center, broad spiral stone stairs lead UP to the Floor 3 Heart-Pit ('oh'). A large iron hearth warms the crowd.

features.label: the central stone stairs
features.inspect_text: Solid granite stairs ascending into the dark ceiling toward Floor 3.

title: Elder Rashid's Quarters
summary: A modest stone house lined with bookshelves, maps of the cavern system, and brass surveying instruments.
inspect_text: Elder Rashid sits here at a heavy oak desk, head in his hands, surrounded by official military decrees and the requisition roll for Zayd.

features.label: the requisition roll
features.inspect_text: A parchment document bearing Captain Malik's iron seal, demanding one youth as an offering.

title: Yasmin's Bakery
summary: A warm, flour-dusted bakery smelling wonderfully of fresh flatbread, sesame, and roasted dates.
inspect_text: A huge brick oven heated by copper steam coils dominates the back. Yasmin stands by the counter, tearful and furious over Zayd's capture.

features.label: the steam-heated oven
features.inspect_text: A massive domed brick hearth with steam pipes wrapping its base, baking scores of flatbreads.

title: High Signal Tower
summary: The highest bastion of the military complex. An iron tower overlooking both the garrison courtyard and the outer village.
inspect_text: A massive parabolic mirror and carbon-arc signal lamp stand ready to flash coded flashes across the underground kingdom.

features.label: carbon-arc signal lamp
features.inspect_text: A heavy brass projector with geared elevation cranks and a silvered glass reflector.

title: Southwest Steam Bastion
summary: A fortified corner tower bristling with high-pressure steam cannons mounted on swivel carriages.
inspect_text: Heavy iron plating protects the gunners. Compressed steam hoses feed directly from the central boilers.

features.label: swivel steam cannon
features.inspect_text: A heavy brass-jacketed barrel fitted with a quick-action ball valve and pressure reservoir.

title: Southeast Steam Bastion
summary: The twin corner bastion, commanding clear fields of fire across the eastern village approach road.
inspect_text: Ammo lockers hold racks of solid steel bolts designed to be fired in rapid bursts by steam pressure.

features.label: rack of steam bolts
features.inspect_text: Heavy pointed steel projectiles arranged in brass feeding clips.

title: West Rampart Walk
summary: A stone-and-iron battlewalk atop the western curtain wall, guarded by pacing soldiers in polished breastplates.
inspect_text: Braziers of coke burn in iron baskets, cutting through the cavern chill.

features.label: iron rampart brazier
features.inspect_text: A stout iron basket glowing hot with burning anthracite coal.

title: Guard Armory
summary: A secure chamber lined with racks of crossbows, halberds, and reinforced brass shields.
inspect_text: An armorer's anvil stands in the corner, ringed by hammers and tongs for field repairs.

features.label: crossbow rack
features.inspect_text: Neatly slotted wall racks holding military heavy crossbows with steel prods.

title: West Soldier Barracks
summary: A tidy room of double-tiered iron bunkbeds and footlockers for the garrison's watchmen.
inspect_text: Uniforms hang neatly on wall pegs. The floor is scrubbed stone, smelling of floor wax and gun oil.

features.label: soldier footlocker
features.inspect_text: An iron-bound wooden chest stenciled with the company regimental insignia.

title: Sentry Post West
summary: An enclosed observation cupola with narrow glass slit-windows looking out over the village roofs.
inspect_text: A brass speaking-tube connects directly to the officer's command desk.

features.label: brass speaking-tube
features.inspect_text: A polished brass trumpet mouthpiece with an attached whistle stopper.

title: Northwest Rampart Walk
summary: The upper rampart near the apex, where the wall joins the natural rock roof of the cavern.
inspect_text: Steam conduits run along the parapet walk to prevent ice accumulation from upper drafts.

features.label: parapet steam line
features.inspect_text: A small copper tracer pipe wrapped in insulation alongside the stone battlement.

title: Northeast Rampart Walk
summary: The eastern high battlewalk overlooking the deep mine approach drifts.
inspect_text: Guards patrol with mechanical clockwork chronometers strapped to their belts to log their rounds.

features.label: guard log chronometer
features.inspect_text: A brass case clock with a rotating paper dial punched by patrol keys.

title: Officer's Quarters
summary: A comfortable room with wool rugs, mahogany lockers, and decanters of imported brandy.
inspect_text: Framed maps of the three concentric triangles hang on the wall, showing mine output projections.

features.label: framed mine map
features.inspect_text: A detailed topographical map showing chalk vein thickness and daily quota targets.

title: East Soldier Barracks
summary: A second dormitory for off-duty soldiers, filled with the snores of tired sentries.
inspect_text: Boot scrapers and umbrella stands sit beside the door; wool blankets cover every bunk.

features.label: tiered iron bunk
features.inspect_text: A sturdy angle-iron bed frame fitted with a straw paillasse and wool blanket.

title: Sentry Post East
summary: An elevated watch-station monitoring the eastern rail approaches and tailing dumps.
inspect_text: A trip-wire alarm bell hangs overhead, linked to sensors along the outer perimeter wall.

features.label: trip-wire alarm bell
features.inspect_text: A bronze bell with an electric clapper wired to external trip-cords.

title: East Rampart Walk
summary: The lower eastern parapet leading down toward the southeast bastion.
inspect_text: Stacked boxes of quick-lime and chalk-resistant grease sit covered beneath waterproof canvas tarps.

features.label: tarpaulin supply stack
features.inspect_text: Heavy waxed canvas lashed tight over military provisions.

title: Timber Stockade East
summary: Heavy vertical iron-sheathed logs form the outer palisade wall facing the village approach.
inspect_text: Crossbow slits cut at chest height provide defensive cover for defenders inside.

features.label: iron-sheathed log
features.inspect_text: Solid pine trunk clad in quarter-inch boiler plate.

title: Drill Grounds
summary: A cleared courtyard of packed earth where soldiers drill with halberds and practice formations.
inspect_text: Wooden training dummies with notched cuirasses stand along the wall.

features.label: wooden training dummy
features.inspect_text: A heavily scarred pine post fitted with straw arms and iron helmet.

title: The Brass Bulkhead Gate
summary: The monumental front portal of the garrison. Two towering doors of solid brass, three feet thick, seal the complex.
inspect_text: Operated by massive hydraulic pistons and gear-wheels. The gate requires official clearance to open.

features.label: the massive brass gate
features.inspect_text: Gleaming brass doors stamped with company serial numbers, locked with four hydraulic deadbolts.

title: Guard Mess Hall
summary: A large dining hall with long wooden trestle tables smelling of roast mutton, cabbage, and stale ale.
inspect_text: Tin plates and pewter tankards sit drying on dish racks beside a large cast-iron cookstove.

features.label: cast-iron cookstove
features.inspect_text: A six-burner range with two baking ovens, radiating heat day and night.

title: Steam Smithy
summary: A roaring workshop equipped with a steam trip-hammer, two open forges, and quench tubs.
inspect_text: The blacksmith hammers glowing iron bars into replacement piston rods and prison bars.

features.label: steam trip-hammer
features.inspect_text: A half-ton iron hammerhead driven rapidly up and down by an overhead steam cylinder.

title: Captain Malik's Headquarters
summary: A grand tent of reinforced sailcloth erected within the inner courtyard, furnished with campaign tables and brass chests.
inspect_text: Captain Malik directs the garrison from here. In a locked brass strongbox on his desk lies the ancient **Teleportation Scroll**.

features.label: Malik's brass strongbox
features.inspect_text: A heavy iron-banded chest secured with a complex tumbler lock. Inside lies the Teleportation Scroll.

title: The Iron Prison Cage
summary: A suspended iron cage hanging over a dry stone pit in the shadow of the central Calcinator.
inspect_text: Inside sits **Zayd (age 11)**, dirty-faced and furious, gripping the iron bars and yelling at his captors. Nearby stands the silent, robed **Priest Harun**.

features.label: the suspended prison cage
features.inspect_text: Heavy vertical iron bars riveted to a solid hoop frame. Zayd is trapped inside, waiting for the gate.

title: The Great Chalk Calcinator
summary: The beating industrial heart of the floor: an enormous spherical brass boiler twenty feet in diameter, wrapped in steam pipes.
inspect_text: Crushed chalk ore is fed into top hoppers and super-heated by high-pressure steam, vaporizing it into glowing white aether-vapor that feeds the teleport gate.

features.label: the spherical calcinator
features.inspect_text: A titanic brass pressure vessel vibrating with deafening power, venting luminescent steam through copper conduits.

title: The Teleportation Gate
summary: A colossal archway of polished basalt and brass, wrapped in thick copper cables that pulse with blinding white light.
inspect_text: The arch frames an unstable, swirling white vortex powered by vaporized chalk from the Calcinator. This is the gateway to **Floor 5**.

features.label: the swirling teleportation vortex
features.inspect_text: A roaring oval of pure luminous white energy, tearing through space down toward Floor 5.
